newsitem.title: BELGIUM: DHL Aviation wet-leases two Boeing 727s.
newsitem.headline: DHL Aviation wet-leases two Boeing 727s.

text.p: DHL Aviation, the air transport arm of the DHL group, said it added two Boeing 727Fs to its intra-European fleet earlier this month.
The two aircraft, a 727-100F and 727-200F, have been wet-leased from the U.S. based Express One International, a DHL Aviation official told Reuters.

"The steady growth in our European traffic means we need to have more capacity in hand, especially during peak periods of market demand such as the one we are entering now in the final quarter of the year."
DHL now operates a fleet of 18 727-200Fs and eight 727-100Fs on intra-European routes, the official added.
The company is part of the DHL Worldwide Express group whose main shareholders are Deutsche Lufthansa AG and Japan Airlines Co Ltd
